[CI] Fix Main2Main fresh-mode upstream reference (#12988)

### What this PR does / why we need it?
Fix a Main2Main regression introduced by:
- https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/pull/12279

PR moved `upstream` setup into the incremental-only `FIXED_BASE_SHA`
condition. When a baseline rebase conflicts, the workflow falls back to
fresh mode with an empty `FIXED_BASE_SHA`, so `upstream/main` is not
created:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm-ascend/actions/runs/30284552529/job/90040429009.

`main2main_flow` then fails during initialization:

```text
fatal: Not a valid object name upstream/main
```

This change:

- derives the fixed upstream base from `base_sha` or `source_ref`;
- configures `upstream` in both fresh and incremental modes;
- pins `upstream/main` to the resolved SHA instead of fetching a moving
main;
- preserves the existing incremental rebase behavior.

### Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

### How was this patch tested?


- vLLM version: v0.25.1
- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/fe784ff22e630a31fd798f392b01e0a75c18f047

---------

Signed-off-by: MrZ20 <2609716663@qq.com>

             "refs/heads/main2main_baseline:refs/remotes/main2main/main2main_baseline" 2>/dev/null; then
             BASELINE_SHA=$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/main2main/main2main_baseline)

@@ -329,19 +334,26 @@ jobs:

+          UPSTREAM_BASE_SHA="${UPSTREAM_REBASE_SHA:-$CHECKOUT_SOURCE_SHA}"

-              git remote set-url upstream "https://github.com/${UPSTREAM_REPO}.git"
-            git fetch upstream "$FIXED_BASE_REF"
-            git cat-file -e "${FIXED_BASE_SHA}^{commit}"

[BugFix][main][cherry-pick] Dedupe load keys + document use_layerwise + lower load_gvas log (#12801)

## What this PR does / why we need it?

Cherry-pick of #12797 onto `main`:

1. **fix(kv_pool)**: Dedupe lease keys in the layerwise load path.
`build_shared` accumulated `request.load_keys` once per `(task,
block_range)` and `load_thread` again per task, inflating
`batch_remove_lease` key count to N x `add_lease` (N = block-range/task
fan-out; observed 3x in PD-mixed kv_both, 6x in PD-disagg DP=4/TP=4).
Dedupe by request in `build_shared` and at the final remove point so
`remove` count matches `add` count.

2. **docs(kv_pool)**: Document `use_layerwise` in the KV Pool parameter
table (enables layer-by-layer KV save/load, Prefill node only, memcache
backend only).

3. **perf(kv_pool)**: Lower `load_gvas` log level from info to debug
(hot-path noise).

## Does this PR introduce _any_ user-facing change?

No correctness change - `batch_remove_lease` on duplicate keys is
idempotent in memcache; this only removes the inflated call count. New
doc entry for `use_layerwise`. Log level change only.

## How was this patch tested?

- Verified `load_thread released N leases` == sum of per-group
`load_gvas keys` (2849 == 2849) after fix (was 8547 == 3x before).
- Warmup + repeat requests: outputs consistent, no corruption; External
prefix cache hit rate 0% -> 40.3% -> 53.7%.
- `ruff format --check` passed.

- vLLM version: v0.25.1
- vLLM main:
https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/commit/fe784ff22e630a31fd798f392b01e0a75c18f047

Signed-off-by: tyy0829 <1455207791@qq.com>
